integrity_note: The argument is self-contained and uses no externally certified proof. Finite-prefix calculations are corroborative rather than proofs of infinitary attainment; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns attainment of modal extrema, not decidability, modal validity or finite-model size. Positive-degree cutoff and finite-image clauses classify individual scalar inputs and do not imply closure under nesting. For full modal formulas only the unrestricted row conditions are asserted. An older extremum or fuzzy-relation theorem under different terminology may subsume some of the statements.
title: Sharp witness spectrum of infinite Gödel modal frames
